Abres con un especial (opener) y cuando: You open with a special (opener) and when it hits you press a punch or kick: an auto-double comes out (two hits on their own). With the classic rule, the button depends on the special's strength: heavy → medium, medium → light, light → heavy. A jump-in air attack also opens one. From there you cancel into another special (linker) and repeat (up to 4 auto-doubles); the heavy version of a special after an auto-double is the ender: it knocks down and closes the combo. The one receiving it breaks it with punch + kick of the same strength as the hit that just landed; if they miss, they're locked out for 3 seconds. Auto-doubles only come out with the opponent close (the character doesn't run to them), and a super only opens auto-doubles if you tick it in its ⚙ Settings.
